entities.name: South Zelenchuksky Church
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The South Zelenchuksky Church is a former Alanian church located in modern-day Arkhyz, Russia, dating to the late 10th century or early 11th century. The church's modest size suggests that it was privately owned, potentially by a member of the nobility.
